Class IAuraBackendCreator

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Aura
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Factory for creating IAuraBackend instances. Allows querying available graphics adapters and selecting an API version before creating the backend. Obtain one via the static factory methods such as CreateD3d12() or CreateD3d11().

public class IAuraBackendCreator : AuraResourcePointer, IDisposable

EnableDebugMode()

This will enable debug mode for the backend. For d3d12, there must be no devices created in the entire process before the one you're about to make. This only works if you don't pass in your own device.
